meta.name: Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
meta.description:
Anushka and Virat, two young lawyers once in love, find their destinies intertwined again. This time though, the stakes are higher with the complexities of love entwined with professional rivalry and starkly different work ideologies.

Not complete. On your server: S1 65/102 (missing E66-102)

videos.title: Justice Is Blind
videos.overview: Anushka is a sharp lawyer who works at her father's reputed law firm and has an ethical outlook. However, her father, Rajdeep Raisinghani, wants her to be ruthless in court. Unbeknownst to them, their lives are about to go through an unexpected change as someone seeks to destroy the Raisinghani family from within.

videos.title: Landmark Decision
videos.overview: Anushka gets the news about her father's accident. In Rajdeep's absence, the chairman position of Raisinghani law becomes a point of contention between Anushka and Virat. Will Anushka be able to prove her worth as a lawyer?

videos.title: Family Legacy
videos.overview: Virat and a few other lawyers resign from the firm when Anushka becomes the head of Raisinghani Legal. How will Anushka deal with this crisis?

videos.title: The Deciding Factor
videos.overview: Anushka learns that Rajdeep has slipped into a coma, and her grandmother blames her for it. Later, the police contact Anushka with some critical information about the accident.

videos.title: Star Client
videos.overview: Anushka decides to meet cricket superstar Aryaman Singh at a party and offers to become his legal representative. However, Virat also arrives at the party to steal a potential client from Anushka.

videos.title: The Best Bet
videos.overview: Virat and Anushka are at odds as both of them want to make Aryaman a part of their clientele. Who will be the one to win his trust?

videos.title: Finding The Middle Ground
videos.overview: Aryaman asks Virat and Anuska to team up and fight the case as his lawyers. Can they work together to prove Aryaman's innocence?

videos.title: Connecting The Dots
videos.overview: Anushka and Virat scramble to find a breakthrough in Aryaman's case as the court denies their bail plea. Meanwhile, Anushka takes it upon herself to investigate her father's accident.

videos.title: Joint Strategy
videos.overview: Anushka and Virat find out that their college batchmate, Raghav, is representing the opposition in Aryaman's case. After receiving this new information, both of them decide to come up with a better strategy.

videos.title: A New Beginning
videos.overview: Virat and Anushka manage to get bail for Aryaman with their new strategy. While celebrating their achievement, Anushka finds out that Virat is getting engaged soon.

videos.title: The Outsider
videos.overview: Anushka goes to the police station to collect Aryaman's call records. Meanwhile, Virat starts having second thoughts about his engagement to Ayesha.

videos.title: Personal Problems
videos.overview: Anushka decides to withdraw from Aryaman's case as a part of her strategy, wanting to focus all of her attention on her father's accident. What will she find?

videos.title: The Case Of Love
videos.overview: Anushka decides to find some new clients to boost her firm's reputation. Meanwhile, Ankita gives Virat some advice to win back Anushka's trust. Will he be able to do it?

videos.title: Office Politics
videos.overview: Anushka decides to give some of Virat's clients to the other senior members of the firm. Meanwhile, Anushka's new friend, Akshat, arrives at her house for dinner.

videos.title: Sacred Bonds
videos.overview: Virat agrees to give up some of his clients for the firm's sake, while Anushka decides to check on Ankita when she doesn't show up for work.

videos.title: The Special Prosecutor
videos.overview: Anushka gets the opportunity to become a special prosecutor for an important case. However, accepting this case would put her at odds with Akshat. What will she do?

videos.title: A New Perspective
videos.overview: Anushka feels conflicted about her new case. Meanwhile, Virat gets into a fight with Raghav outside the court.

videos.title: Love And Destiny
videos.overview: Ankita lands herself in trouble while researching a case. Meanwhile, Anushka confesses her feelings for Akshat.

videos.title: One For All
videos.overview: After taking up the job of a special prosecutor, Anushka decides to make some changes to the firm. She decides to make Virat the head while she is working on the case. Is she making the right choice?

videos.title: Relationship Trouble
videos.overview: Anushka faces problems while dealing with the investigating officer of a case. Meanwhile, Virat asks for Ankita's advice on breaking up with Ayesha.

videos.title: Soul Searching
videos.overview: Anushka continues her investigation into the Tara Kaul case. Meanwhile, Akshat asks for Anushka's help to get Virat and Ayesha closer.

videos.title: Safe Place
videos.overview: Akshat agrees to assist Anushka with the case. Later, Virat confesses his love to Anushka. What will be Anushka's answer?

videos.title: Star Maker
videos.overview: Anushka meets with Prashant's ex-wife to get more information about the case. Meanwhile, Virat makes some changes to the firm and keeps it a secret from Anushka.

videos.title: The Relationship Game
videos.overview: Anushka meets with the doctors and learns valuable information from Tara's autopsy reports. Later, Anushka and Virat get into an argument about their relationship.

videos.title: Karmic Justice
videos.overview: Ankita asks to live with Anushka at her house when she gets thrown out of her apartment. Meanwhile, Anushka confronts Virat about his recent behaviour at the office.

videos.title: Emotional Centre
videos.overview: Ankita tries to win over Anushka's family members while living in her house. Meanwhile, Virat asks Anushka for a second chance. What will Anushka do?

videos.title: Master Key
videos.overview: Virat reaches a landmark judgement in an important case. Meanwhile, Ankita makes her next move to solidify her place in the Raisinghani house.

videos.title: Challenges And Commitments
videos.overview: Anushka faces a challenging situation in court as Rajdeep's old rival, Rachel Simon, takes over as the defence lawyer. Meanwhile, Virat causes problems in the firm due to his treatment of the junior employees. What will Anushka do?

videos.title: Trust Issues
videos.overview: Ankita wants to extend her stay at Anushka's house and thinks of ways to impress her family members. Meanwhile, a junior employee takes drastic measures upon being pressurized by Virat.

videos.title: A Twist Of Fate
videos.overview: Anushka and Akshat's relationship goes through a rough patch when Akshat agrees to become the witness for the opposing side in the Tara Kaul case. Meanwhile, Virat apologizes to Rumina for his past behaviour in front of everyone at the firm.

videos.title: Falling-out
videos.overview: Virat feels cheated by Anushka, and both of them have a falling-out. Later, he resigns from the position of the managing leading lawyer. What will Anushka do now?

videos.title: North Star
videos.overview: Anushka meets with Virat and tries to change his mind about resigning. Meanwhile, Anushka finds out that Tara's sister hid the truth from her regarding the case. What will she do now?

videos.title: Commitment Issues
videos.overview: Raghav calls Anushka to tell her about his engagement. Meanwhile, Ankita searches for a case file in Anushka's house behind her back.

videos.title: Heart Of Gold
videos.overview: Anushka and her team consult with Tara's parents to prepare for the case. However, an unpredictable testimony from Tara's mother complicates the case even more. What will Anushka do now?

videos.title: Old Mistakes
videos.overview: Anushka reprimands Ankita and Rumina for messing up during the court hearing. Meanwhile, Virat gets a panic attack when he finds out that his mother is trying to call him.

videos.title: Reasonable Doubt
videos.overview: Anushka goes to meet Akshat at his office when he starts ignoring her calls. Meanwhile, Anushka's grandmother gets suspicious of Ankita and wants to kick her out of the house.

videos.title: Moral Compass
videos.overview: Anushka's family members think that Ankita is responsible for Rajdeep's recovery, and they let her stay in the house. Meanwhile, Akshat tries to reach out to Anushka and arrives at the court hearing to meet her.

videos.title: The Bigger Picture
videos.overview: Anushka is unable to keep up with Rachel Simon in court. Things take a turn for the worse when an important witness doesn't show up for the hearing. What will Anushka do now?

videos.title: Key Witness
videos.overview: Anushka meets mafia boss Dada Kamble to help find the missing witness for her case. Later, Ankita hands her resignation to Anushka for messing up during the court hearing.

videos.title: The Firm's Legacy
videos.overview: The firm comes under immense pressure after Anushka's defeat in the Tara Kaul case. Virat and the others are worried about the firm's viability and call for a partnership bid. Meanwhile, Anushka decides to break things off with Akshat.

videos.title: Buried Secrets
videos.overview: Anushka reaches out to Dada Kamble again for more information about her father's accident. Meanwhile, Harsh and Virat begin to dig deep into the Mehta Group case.

videos.title: Uncovering The Mystery
videos.overview: Anushka is worried as the firm is undergoing a financial crunch. Virat continues his investigation into the Mehta case. Later, Anushka finds the truck that caused her father's accident.

videos.title: Calculated Risk
videos.overview: Virat asks Anushka to accompany him for his therapy sessions. Meanwhile, Anushka's uncle gets a business offer from a rival firm.

videos.title: The Big Catch
videos.overview: Virat finds out that Dev is speaking to a rival firm for a merger. Meanwhile, Anushka confronts a journalist about the articles being published against her.

videos.title: One Step At A Time
videos.overview: Raghav and Dev ask Virat to convince Anushka for the merger. Meanwhile, Anushka asks Imran to help her investigate Rajdeep's accident.

videos.title: Blank Slate
videos.overview: Virat and Dev think of ways to convince Anushka for the merger. Meanwhile, Anushka meets Dada Kamble to step down from the case.

videos.title: Golden Opportunity
videos.overview: Virat surprises Anushka at the guest house and asks for a second chance. Meanwhile, Anushka gets a new tip from the journalist Imran Basheer.

videos.title: Guiding Light
videos.overview: Anushka feels betrayed when Virat and the others propose a merger in front of her. Will Virat be able to convince her?

videos.title: Securing The Future
videos.overview: Anushka's cousin, Siddharth, joins the firm as an assistant lawyer. Meanwhile, Ankita approaches a family to help reopen their old case.

videos.title: The Bitter Truth
videos.overview: Anushka asks for Virat's help with the Dada Kamble case. Later, Anushka finds out some shocking information about her father and his past.

videos.title: Unfortunate Coincidence
videos.overview: Anushka begins to question Rajdeep's legacy when she finds out about his involvement in illegal affairs. What will she do now?

videos.title: Making The Connection
videos.overview: Rajdeep's health worsens, and he is rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile, Virat formulates a strategy with Aryaman for his case.

videos.title: Valuable Player
videos.overview: Anushka finds out that Imran is hiding something from her. Meanwhile, Ankita and Harsh begin work on their new case.

videos.title: The Great Writ
videos.overview: Virat finds out that Imran is the stalker who has been following Anushka for the past seven years. Later, Ayesha asks Anushka to help her win Virat's heart.

videos.title: Last Minute Tips For Virat
videos.overview: Virat tries to apologise to Anushka in the office while Ankita emphasises the importance of her case to Harsh. Later, Anushka gives Virat a few last-minute tips to make his proposal to Ayesha on Valentine's Day romantic.

videos.title: Secrets and Revelations
videos.overview: Harsh reveals to Virat and Ankita the nature of the connection between Vayu Energy, Mehta Group and Shruti Yadav. Meanwhile, Anushka meets with Dada Kamble to try and get important information from him regarding his case.

videos.title: Strong Evidence
videos.overview: Harsh and Ankita are able to acquire evidence, that is strong enough to reopen the Mehtas' case. Anushka is informed about her father's unpredictable recovery. Later, while Anushka and Virat are at the hospital, the emergency alarm goes off in Rajdeep's room.

videos.title: Gayatri's Trust
videos.overview: The doctors manage to stabilise Rajdeep while Virat questions the security lapse in the hospital. Meanwhile, Dheeraj and Dev clash over Gayatri's decision to trust Anushka, as Ankita asks her mother if she's ready to go to Raisinghani Mansion.

videos.title: Anushka's Fear
videos.overview: A rattled Anushka tells Virat that Ishan Talwar has returned and was the public prosecutor against her in the Dada Kamble case. Meanwhile, Ankita and Harsh fight over the status of their relationship.

videos.title: The Darkness
videos.overview: Ishan confides in Anushka about his struggle with darkness and the steps he took to pull himself out of it. Meanwhile, Mr. Mehta decides to focus on his international business and instructs Virat to not take any hearing dates for pending cases until he returns.

videos.title: No Time For Love
videos.overview: Virat suspects that someone else is pulling the strings when Anushka expresses her frustration at Basheer's increasing demands for money. Meanwhile, Harsh tells Ankita that one can't plan when to fall in love after she tells him that she has no time for it. Will Ankita confront her feelings for Harsh?

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.overview: Anushka tells her family that Virat and she have decided to be friends, much to their disappointment. Meanwhile, Dev speaks to Dhiraj of ongoing talks to create a new firm and expresses his skepticism of his brother's complete recovery.

videos.title: Upholding The Law
videos.overview: When questioned about how Dada Kamble came to possess a .38 calibre gun from Kanpur, Anushka reminds the inspector that Dada Kamble is illegally detained. She and Virat then assert that it is a lawyer's job to ensure the police follow the law.

videos.title: Mr Raisinghani Is Delicate
videos.overview: The doctor informs Anushka that her father is in critical condition and that they will do their best to help him. Virat assures them that the culprit will be caught. Later, crucial information about the case is discussed in court.

videos.title: Search Warrant For Anushka's Office
videos.overview: A team from the Financial Crime Directorate arrives at Anushka's office looking for her, intending to search and seize documents related to the ongoing Mehta Case in court. They ask her to hand over all documents for their investigation into the money laundering case. How will Anushka handle this situation?
